w10_T4_001945: The first cut of Ana's documentary ran for 191 minutes. Her producer made her remove a 140-minute section of interviews, and then she added a 35-minute sequence filmed at the harbour. After a test screening she cut 13 minutes from the opening and 30 minutes from the ending. Ana keeps her edit notes in minutes rather than hours, since sixty minutes make one hour. How many minutes long is the documentary now?
w10_T4_001950: In the archive's new storage system, each folder holds 143 scanned pages, a project is made of 7 folders plus a 25-page index that is stored alongside them. Each drive stores 8 such projects, each rack holds 8 drives, and the server room has 8 racks. The room is 30 metres long, and the archivist has worked there for a dozen years. How many scanned pages does the server room hold in total?
w10_T4_001960: Ben and Cara are training for a charity ride, and Cara keeps a dozen spare inner tubes in her garage. In the first week Ben rode for 204 minutes. He then rode 27 minutes on Monday, 30 minutes on Tuesday, 21 minutes on Wednesday, and 44 minutes on Thursday of the second week, which was more riding than Cara managed in both weeks together. Ben logs everything in minutes rather than hours, since sixty minutes make one hour. How many minutes has Ben ridden in total?
w10_T4_001961: A garden tap fills a rain tank at 72 litres per hour when fully open. Dan turned the tap so that it delivered exactly half that flow, and he ran it at that rate for 7 hours every day for 5 days into the empty tank. He then used half of the water in the tank on the lawn. A crack in the tank later leaked 552 litres. How many litres of water are left in the tank?
w10_T4_001965: Fern started the month with 238 dollars in her account. She received 50 dollars for tutoring, then paid 85 dollars for a phone bill and 146 dollars for a train pass. Her sister sent her 30 dollars, and she spent 49 dollars on groceries, which she carries home in a dozen small bags. Her friend Gus, who never spends much, still has more money than Fern does now. How many dollars does Fern have now?
w10_T4_001968: The concert hall's main block has rows of 196 seats with an extra 78 seats along the side aisles, and the balcony holds twice as many seats as that whole block. Tickets cost 25 dollars each. The festival uses 9 halls that are all laid out with a balcony that size, and it runs for 3 nights with the balconies full every night. How many balcony seats are filled over the festival?
w10_T4_001974: In the morning the delivery van set off with 105 litres of fuel in its tank. The long morning run to the coast used 64 litres, and the driver burned 2 litres idling in a queue at the ferry. In the afternoon the return trip used 28 litres. In the evening a short trip to the depot used 5 litres. How many litres of fuel are left in the tank?
w10_T4_001975: In the morning Hiro had 103 lemons on his stall and gave 58 of them to the school kitchen, leaving him with more than Ines had on her stall. In the afternoon Hiro sold every lemon he had left at 8 cents each and put the money in his tin, and one customer added a 21-cent tip to the tin. In the evening he sold a jug of lemonade for 61 cents and put that in the tin too. How many cents are in Hiro's tin now?
w10_T4_001977: In the morning a builder's merchant delivered 6 pallets of bricks, with 98 bricks on each pallet, and the site manager split them equally among his 3 building sites. Later in the morning the Mill Lane site received its share. In the afternoon 69 spare bricks from a demolition were added to the Mill Lane pile. In the evening the manager placed an order for the same number of bricks as the Mill Lane pile now held, to arrive on each of the next 8 working days, for each of his 2 new sites. How many bricks did the manager order?
w10_T4_001979: Jo has been putting 171 dollars into her savings account every week, and this year she raised that by 36 dollars a week, which is more than her brother Kel manages to save each week. She kept up the new weekly amount for 8 weeks. Her grandmother then added 36 dollars to the account, and the bank paid 16 dollars in interest. How many dollars has Jo added to the account this year?
w10_T4_001980: On Saturday morning Lars's bakery had 214 bread rolls ready and baked 68 more. Mina's bakery, which has 12 ovens, had 7 times as many rolls as Lars did that morning, so Mina's was the busier shop. In the afternoon Mina sold 844 rolls and gave 63 rolls to a shelter. In the evening she sold every roll she had left at 5 cents each. How many cents did Mina take in the evening?
w10_T4_001982: In the morning Nell checked the first seed tray in her nursery: it had been sown with 71 seeds but 54 of them had failed to sprout. Each of her shelves holds 3 trays like that one, every tray with the same number of sprouted seedlings, and each greenhouse has 7 shelves. Each tray is 40 centimetres wide. In the afternoon she confirmed that all 7 of her greenhouses matched the first one. In the evening she reported that all 5 farms in the cooperative had grown exactly the same as hers, a dozen years after the cooperative was founded. How many seedlings sprouted across the cooperative?
w10_T4_001987: At the party 45 balloons were shared equally among the 5 children, and Ola got her share. The party lasted 3 hours. During the games 8 of Ola's balloons popped. A clown then gave Ola 44 balloons, and on the way home her father bought her 27 more at a shop. How many balloons does Ola have now?
w10_T4_001991: Pim earns 44 dollars a day at the cafe plus 17 dollars a day in tips, and he worked 8 days this fortnight. His manager gave him a 46-dollar bonus for covering a dozen extra shifts over the year. He then paid 467 dollars in rent. How many dollars does Pim have left from this fortnight's earnings?
w10_T4_001997: In the morning Quinn brought 6 crates of eggs to the market, each holding 170 eggs, and sold 817 eggs before lunch to a restaurant that paid her separately. In the afternoon she sold every remaining egg to her dozen regulars at 8 cents each, and one of them added a 14-cent tip. The market is 12 kilometres from her farm. In the evening she worked out that her afternoon takings had been exactly the same on each of the 3 market days that week. How many cents did Quinn take in over those 3 afternoons in total?
w10_T4_001998: On Monday morning Rae made 88 cents selling lemonade, and her brother Sol made twice as much as Rae at his own stand, so Sol was ahead. On Monday afternoon Sol made another 59 cents. Sol made exactly the same amount as he had on Monday on each of the 4 days from Monday to Thursday. On Thursday evening he spent 333 cents on a comic. Sol keeps his money in cents rather than dollars, remembering that one hundred cents make a dollar. How many cents does Sol have left?
w10_T4_002003: Tim reads 138 words a minute. His sister Una reads 4 times as many words a minute as Tim, so she is by far the faster reader of the two. Una reads for 7 minutes every morning before school, on each of the 5 school days in a week, and she has kept that up for 6 weeks, half a dozen weeks in all. On the last day she also read a 4-word sign on the way to school. How many words has Una read in total?
w10_T4_002004: In the morning a greengrocer received 4 boxes of apples with 131 apples in each box, and he threw away 31 apples that were bruised. In the afternoon a farmer dropped off 37 more apples, and a neighbour brought 9 apples from her garden. In the evening the greengrocer sold 521 apples to a cider maker. How many apples does he have left?
w10_T4_002006: The rowing club's 9 members each paid 181 dollars into the boat fund, and a passer-by donated 38 dollars. A sponsor then agreed to make the fund 4 times as large as it was. The club has met at the same boathouse for 15 years. The club spent 4478 dollars from the fund on a new boat. How many dollars are left in the boat fund?
w10_T4_002009: On Saturday morning Vi had 210 dollars in her purse. She paid 186 dollars for a train ticket and then received a 19-dollar refund for a cancelled booking. In the afternoon she spent 39 dollars on lunch with a friend. In the evening the friend paid her back 70 dollars from an earlier loan, and Vi spent 21 dollars on a taxi home. Vi counts in dollars rather than cents, since one hundred cents make a dollar. How many dollars does Vi have now?
w10_T4_002013: The Riverbank stadium has 124 seats in each section, 3 sections in each stand, and 8 stands around the pitch. This season the club added 14 seats in a new press box and 45 seats in a hospitality area. The stadium was built 30 years ago. Every seat was sold for each of the 4 home games this month. How many tickets were sold for those 4 games?
w10_T4_002030: Wes, who is 9 years old, was allowed 123 minutes of screen time on each school day. His parents cut that by 63 minutes and then by another 11 minutes a day. There are 5 school days in a week, and at the weekend he gets a bonus of 72 minutes on top of his school-day total. His parents kept this weekly plan for 5 weeks, which felt like a dozen years to Wes. How many minutes of screen time did Wes get over those 5 weeks?
w10_T4_002031: Xu's cafe sells 75 cups of coffee each morning and twice that many cups over the whole day. On top of the coffees, the cafe sells 29 pots of tea each day. Xu's cafe is open 7 days a week, and the festival season lasts 3 weeks with the same sales every day. How many drinks does the cafe sell during the festival season?
w10_T4_002051: A bolt costs 21 cents at the hardware store, and a bundle contains 9 bolts. The store takes 87 cents off the bundle price for trade customers and then adds 19 cents of packaging to every bundle. Yara orders boxes of 9 bundles, crates of 4 boxes, and she needs 9 crates for her workshop, which is a bigger order than her rival Zed ever places. Yara does her sums in cents rather than dollars, knowing that one hundred cents make a dollar. How many cents will Yara pay for the 9 crates?
w10_T4_002056: In the morning a bakery put 46 cupcakes in its window and sold half of them before noon. In the afternoon the baker made 23 more cupcakes and put them in the window, and then sold 7 cupcakes to a passing family. In the evening 5 cupcakes were given to the staff. How many cupcakes are left in the window?
